title: RetryStrategy provides controls on how to retry a workflow step

backoff.title: Backoff is a backoff strategy to use within retryStrategy

duration.title: Duration is the amount to back off. Default unit is seconds, but could also be a duration (e.g. "2m", "1h")

factor.title: Factor is a factor to multiply the base duration after each failed retry

maxDuration.title: MaxDuration is the maximum amount of time allowed for the backoff strategy

limit.title: Limit is the maximum number of attempts when retrying a container

retryPolicy.title: RetryPolicy is a policy of NodePhase statuses that will be retried
